Over the years I have acquired two Arduinos and they have pretty much sat in the box since I've purchased them. I have two kids, both girls, does anyone have a suggestion for projects? The girls are interested in robots and pranks.

One of the cheapest and the ones I have found the kids get the most into to start out with, is hooking up a piezo speaker and having it make different songs. Usually I just show them how to make it play different tones for different lengths of time and walk away and I have had good luck so far with the kids I have shown this too getting really excited and figuring out how to make it work well.

After things like that, blinking LEDs, using a potentiometer, hooking up a button to and LED, etc, you could have them grab cheap motors/robot kit and put that together.

Since they like pranks, how about an Annoy-a-tron? It's a pretty simple project that will teach input and output basics and Arduino programming. It will also be good for pranking unsuspecting people if hidden well.
